title: AGF Timeline / History Rhymes Section
description: Comparative timeline contrasting two eras of audio industry evolution to surface recurring patterns.

section_number.description: Ordinal label or number for this section in the narrative sequence.

section_label.description: Short label shown in the section eyebrow after the number (e.g. 'The Consolidation').

flip_interval_seconds.description: Auto-flip interval between 'then' and 'now' panes, in seconds. Set higher for a calmer pace.

eras.description: Discrete eras being compared, typically two.

year_range.description: Human-readable date range for the era (e.g., '1950-1985').

events.description: Notable events that define the era.

year.description: Year or year-range of the event.

description.description: Longer narrative description of the event.

comparison_points.description: Side-by-side comparison rows highlighting how patterns rhyme between eras.

insight.description: The takeaway or pattern revealed by the comparison.

appendix.description: markdown — supporting notes for the appendix
